newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Cosmos Machinery shrs suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Cosmos Machinery shrs suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of machinery distributor Cosmos Machinery Enterprises Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Friday.
Shares of Cosmos Machinery gained HK$0.11 or 9.17 percent to HK$1.31 prior to the trading suspension in late morning.
Volume was 2.19 million shares worth HK$2.88 million.
The company had said earlier it was in discussion to buy assets from its parent, Cosmos Machinery (Holdings) Ltd.
